title: lithocarpus paviei
intro: Lithocarpus paviei, commonly known as the Vietnamese copper beech, is a species of tree in the beech family Fagaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lithocarpus paviei include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system.
